scope.summary: Seed and prove archetype ARCH-A per Section 13.27 acceptance archetypes — the operator's signature build: petite frame + extreme-large perky natural tits + narrow soft shoulders + narrow hips + small hands + long legs + round ass + narrow thighs + skinny midriff (OBR-001..004 combined; REQ-005 acceptance: this exact combo renders artifact-free where Daz morph stacking visibly breaks).
acceptance_criteria: BRC-ARCH-A sets: petite height/frame ratio channels; breast volume at extreme over-range with perky ptosis and NATURAL firmness/shape (not the implant profile); narrow clavicle width plus deltoid/trap softness (narrow SOFT shoulders); narrow hip bone width; small hand scale; long-leg bone ratios; round-ass glute volume/roundness; narrow thigh girth; skinny midriff/waist channels.

BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID runs green on the applied body: dialing the breast channels to reach the target moved zero shoulder/hip/thigh/midriff vertices (the founding decoupling requirement proven on the founding archetype).
The body evaluates artifact-free at bake level: no vertex spikes, no crease collapse, volume-preservation post-pass active (REQ-007/009 multi-key tracks in play at the over-range point).
Recipe application is deterministic (BodySpec hash stable) and the archetype registers in the QA iterator for all downstream matrices.
scope.risk_if_missed: The single most explicitly operator-stated body — the combination Daz demonstrably cannot build — goes unproven, meaning BodyKit's core value claim has no pinned evidence.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Run the accepted source assets, anatomy, genital, creator-tool, DCC, visual, and performance corpora with pinned metrics and exact artifact inspection.
